summary: The page is largely correct. The Shannon lower bound proof, the deterministic local-step lemma, the time-to-size simulation, the CIRCUIT-SAT NP-completeness proof, the Cook–Levin corollary via Tseitin, and the two problems/solutions all check out. The only candidate I raised (the padding step in the Shannon bound) survives the defense: appending $g\wedge g$ gates after the output gate keeps the same function and the last gate as output, so no error. No issues to report.
